summary: 100 ft Aermotor on the Sanders family's private land near Crenshaw, Panola County, MS; bought from the MFC in 1991; NHLR-registered June 2022. No build date found.

facts.agency: Sanders family (private owners, per the register's 'Administered by' field); bought from the Mississippi Forestry Commission in 1991

access.note: Register lists the location as private property; no public access is described.

events.note: Bought from the Mississippi Forestry Commission for $105.05 by the Sanders family; the register says it first stood a few miles southeast of the present site. The year it was moved is not given.
Registered June 19, 2022 as US 1604, MS 9; nominated by Jason Johns

notes_for_editor: Almost every tower-specific fact rests on the one NHLR detail page, which is written by a volunteer register contributor. Two searches found nothing else about this tower; the Sanders family's name and the 1991 sale appear only there. The Aermotor and MFC pages are Wikipedia, used for context only; the Aermotor article's 7x7 claim is not tied to this tower. The brief's access 'unknown' is now 'private' from the register's 'Private Property' line. No build date, staffing history or current-condition report was found. The register gives the sale price and the 1991 year with no citation of its own, so treat them as the register's account.
